m: 1. लस् cl. 1. P., (Dhātup. xvii, 64) लसति (only p. लसत्, लसमान, and pf. ललास; Gr. also aor. अलसीत्; fut., लसिता, लसिष्यति), to shine, flash, glitter, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to appear, come to light, arise, Kathās.; to sound, resound, ib. (cf. √ रस्); to play, sport, frolic, Chandom.; to embrace, Dhātup. : Caus., or cl. 10. (Dhātup. xxxiii, 55), लासयति (aor. अलीलसत्; Pass. लास्यते), to dance, R.; to cause to teach to dance, Vikr.; to exercise an art (cf. √ लश्), Dhātup.
a: लस् — I. {c1c} P. (लसति, लसित) 1 To shine, glitter, flash; मुक्तहरेण लसता हसतीव स्तनद्वयं K. P. 10; करवाणि चरणद्वयं सरसलसदलक्तकरागं Gīt. 10; Amaru. 16; N. 22. 53. --2 To appear, arise, come to light. --3 To embrace. --4 To play, frolic about, skip about, dance. --5 To sound, resound. --Caus. (लासयति-ते) 1 To cause to shine, grace, adorn. --2 To cause to dance. --3 To exercise an art.

s: strI, (lasatIti । las + ac .) haridrA । iti hArAvalI । 93 ॥

strI, ikzurasaH । tvaNmAMsamaDyagarasaH । iti kecit ॥ (yaTA । “lasIkA udakaviSezaH । yaTAha carakaH । yattu mAMsatvagantare udakaM tallasIkASabdaM laBate .” iti vijayarakzitakftaprameharogavyAKyAne ॥ “yattu tvagantare vraRagataM lasIkASabdaM laBate .” iti carake SArIrasTAne saptame'DyAye ॥)
m: लसीका f. watery humour in the body, lymph, serum &c., Car.; Bhpr.
the juice of the sugarcane, L.
a: लसीका — 1 Saliva. --2 Pus, matter. --3 The juice of the sugar-cane. --4 Lymph.

m: लस mfn. shining, playing, moving hither and thither (cf. अ-लस)
having the smell of bell-metal, L.
लस m. fever in a camel, L.
लसद्-अंशु mfn. (p. लसत् + अ˚) having flashing or glancing rays (as the sun), MW.
लसक m. a kind of tree, L.
लसक n. a partic. drug, L.

v: strI lasa ac wAp ata ittvam । lAlAyAM Sabdaca॰ ।

a: लसित — p. p. [लस्-क्त] Played, sported, appeared, manifested, skipping about &c.; see लस्.

लस्ज् — {c1c} A. (लज्जते, लज्जित) 1 To be ashamed, feel shame (oft. with instr. or inf.); स्त्रीजनं प्रहरन्कथं न लज्जसे Ratn. 2; Bk. 15. 33. --2 To blush. --Caus. (लज्जयति-ते) To put to shame; R. 19. 14.
